elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study employed ANFIS and ANN models to predict measles occurrences, using evaluation metrics such as R2, RMSE, Pearson correlation coefficient (R), and PBIAS to assess model performance.
elements_en.methods: The models were evaluated using the coefficient of determination (R2), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Pearson correlation coefficient (R), and Percentage Bias (PBIAS) to compare their effectiveness in predicting measles occurrences.
elements_en.main_results: ANFIS, ANN, and MLR showed R values of 0.9810, 0.9960, and 0.9750 for both training and test, with ANN achieving lower RMSE values (0.6790 and 0.6809) and PBIAS values (0.1080 and 0.1142) for training and testing, respectively.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted ANFIS and ANN as effective tools for modeling measles occurrences, highlighting their novelty as valuable resources for public health and decision-makers in enhancing public safety strategies.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a predictive framework for measles occurrences, which can inform public health surveillance, early intervention strategies, and resource allocation to mitigate measles outbreaks.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence strength is moderate, as it relies on abstract-only data without detailed methodology or validation in real-world settings, limiting generalizability.

papers.title_zh: 使用自适应神经模糊推理系统 (ANFIS) 和人工神经网络 (ANN) 的 麻疹 预测建模
papers.source_body_en: Measles, a viral and communicable illness with life-threatening complications, begins with an 8-12-day incubation period accompanied by fever, cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis. The Measles Virus (MeV) enters the alveolar macrophages of the host or its dendritic cells, replicates, and then spreads to the surrounding surfaces. As a result, we focus on the use of Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Systems (ANFIS) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) for the prediction of measles. The models (ANFIS and ANN) were employed and evaluated using the coefficient of determination (R2), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Pearson correlation coefficient (R), and Percentage Bias (PBIAS) as evaluation metrics. The results showed that ANFIS, ANN, and MLR showed R values of 0.9810, 0.9960, and 0.9750 for both training and test. Remarkably, ANN scored lower in terms of the RMSE metric with values of 0.6790 and 0.6809 for both training and testing. In addition, the ANN PBIAS values were 0.1080 and 0.1142 for both training and testing, respectively. In conclusion, ANFIS and ANN have demonstrated effectiveness in modeling measles occurrences, thus, as a valuable tool for public health and decision makers, especially in determining strategies that will enhance public safety.
papers.abstract_zh: 麻疹 是一种病毒性传染性疾病,具有危及生命的并发症,开始时有 8-12 天的潜伏期,伴有发烧、咳嗽、鼻炎和结膜炎。麻疹病毒 (MeV) 进入 宿主 的肺泡巨噬细胞或其树突状细胞,进行复制,然后扩散到周围表面。因此,我们重点关注使用自适应神经模糊推理系统 (ANFIS) 和人工神经网络 (ANN) 来预测 麻疹。使用决定系数 (R2)、均方根误差 (RMSE)、皮尔逊相关系数 (R) 和百分比偏差 (PBIAS) 作为评估指标来采用和评估模型(ANFIS 和 ANN)。结果表明,ANFIS、ANN 和 MLR 在训练和测试中的 R 值为 0.9810、0.9960 和 0.9750。值得注意的是,ANN 在 RMSE 指标方面的得分较低,训练和测试的值为 0.6790 和 0.6809。此外,训练和测试的 ANN PBIAS 值分别为 0.1080 和 0.1142。总之,ANFIS 和 ANN 在建模 麻疹 事件方面证明了有效性,因此,作为公共卫生和决策者的宝贵工具,特别是在确定增强公共安全的策略方面。

papers.title: Country-level immunization recovery and DTP1 no-dose proxy burden after COVID-19: a descriptive ecological analysis of WUENIC, 2010-2024.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Global immunization averages can obscure entity-level shortfalls in access, series completion, measles coverage, and recovery from 2019. We assessed these signals. METHODS: The primary analysis used exact-2024-revision WHO/UNICEF WUENIC records for 194 countries/reporting entities during 2010-2024. We estimated recovery from 2019 and DTP1 no-dose proxy burden, quantified DTP3-MCV1 overlap, and assigned ordered phenotypes. We reproduced benchmarks and conducted source-status, target-population-weighted, threshold, and exact-2025-revision sensitivity analyses. RESULTS: Reproduced weighted 2024 estimates were 88.94% for DTP1, 84.56% for DTP3, and 84.03% for MCV1. Unweighted country fixed-effects estimates for 2024 versus 2019 were - 1.80 percentage points (95% CI -2.75 to -0.84) for DTP1, -2.09 (-3.25 to -0.93) for DTP3, and - 1.65 (-2.72 to -0.58) for MCV1; target-population-weighted estimates were closer to zero and imprecise. The DTP1 no-dose proxy count was 14.26 million; the top 20 entities accounted for 74.6%. Forty-five entities with DTP3 below 80% and MCV1 below 90% accounted for 72.8% of the proxy count. Threshold changes reassigned at most 13.4% of entities. With exact-2025-revision records and the endpoint fixed at 2024, aggregate metrics were similar, but 20 recovery-class and 19 phenotype assignments changed among 194 common entities. CONCLUSION: Aggregate coverage near 2019 levels coexisted with entity-level access, completion, measles, recovery, and data-review signals. Program managers should review them jointly, not as one ranking; assignments are descriptive and revision-specific, not validated risk scores.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review assesses country-level immunization recovery and DTP1 no-dose proxy burden after COVID-19, focusing on access, series completion, measles coverage, and recovery from 2019 across 194 countries/reporting entities during 2010-2024.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A descriptive ecological analysis using WHO/UNICEF WUENIC records, with exact-2024-revision data, estimation of recovery and DTP1 no-dose burden, quantification of DTP3-MCV1 overlap, assignment of ordered phenotypes, and sensitivity analyses including source-status, target-population-weighted, threshold, and exact-2025-revision.

analysis.summary_en: This descriptive ecological analysis of WHO/UNICEF WUENIC records from 194 countries (2010-2024) reveals that while aggregate immunization coverage returned to near-2019 levels in 2024, significant entity-level shortfalls persist. The DTP1 no-dose proxy burden reached 14.26 million, with the top 20 entities accounting for 74.6% of this burden. Sensitivity analyses, including threshold and revision-based changes, highlight the dynamic nature of these estimates. The findings emphasize the need for program managers to jointly review multiple signals—access, completion, measles coverage, recovery, and data review—rather than relying on single rankings, as assignments are descriptive and revision-specific, not validated risk scores.

papers.title_zh: COVID-19 后国家级免疫恢复和 DTP1 无剂量代理负担:WUENIC 的描述性生态分析,2010-2024 年。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Global immunization averages can obscure entity-level shortfalls in access, series completion, measles coverage, and recovery from 2019. We assessed these signals. METHODS: The primary analysis used exact-2024-revision WHO/UNICEF WUENIC records for 194 countries/reporting entities during 2010-2024. We estimated recovery from 2019 and DTP1 no-dose proxy burden, quantified DTP3-MCV1 overlap, and assigned ordered phenotypes. We reproduced benchmarks and conducted source-status, target-population-weighted, threshold, and exact-2025-revision sensitivity analyses. RESULTS: Reproduced weighted 2024 estimates were 88.94% for DTP1, 84.56% for DTP3, and 84.03% for MCV1. Unweighted country fixed-effects estimates for 2024 versus 2019 were - 1.80 percentage points (95% CI -2.75 to -0.84) for DTP1, -2.09 (-3.25 to -0.93) for DTP3, and - 1.65 (-2.72 to -0.58) for MCV1; target-population-weighted estimates were closer to zero and imprecise. The DTP1 no-dose proxy count was 14.26 million; the top 20 entities accounted for 74.6%. Forty-five entities with DTP3 below 80% and MCV1 below 90% accounted for 72.8% of the proxy count. Threshold changes reassigned at most 13.4% of entities. With exact-2025-revision records and the endpoint fixed at 2024, aggregate metrics were similar, but 20 recovery-class and 19 phenotype assignments changed among 194 common entities. CONCLUSION: Aggregate coverage near 2019 levels coexisted with entity-level access, completion, measles, recovery, and data-review signals. Program managers should review them jointly, not as one ranking; assignments are descriptive and revision-specific, not validated risk scores.

papers.title: Ultraviolet-C light for prevention of airborne infection: A baseline analysis of web-based public information.
papers.abstract: Ultraviolet-C (UVC) technology to mitigate airborne infections was first demonstrated in laboratory and epidemiologic studies of influenza and measles in the 1930s, with effectiveness against tuberculosis demonstrated in the 1950s and again in the early 2000s. Yet, UVC was underutilized during the SARS CoV-2 pandemic (COVID-19). Availability, clarity, and actionability of information and messaging on UVC technology may have played a role in limiting policy discussions and uptake of UVC during the COVID-19 pandemic. The purpose of this analysis was to systematically assess the availability, clarity, and actionability of web-based information about UVC for preventing airborne respiratory infections. Student research assistants conducted internet searches using the Google Search engine after receiving a brief orientation to germicidal ultraviolet (GUV) air disinfection. They referred webpages from public health and regulatory organizations whose missions were to regulate UVC or provide recommendations for UVC to prevent transmission of airborne infectious pathogens to the principal investigator (PI). The PI determined whether the webpages met the inclusion criteria. The PI and a doctoral student with experience and training scored the final sample using the CDC's Clear Communication Index (CCI) which assessed public health information on clarity and actionability across four domains. Searches using the Google Search engine for information targeted to the general public yielded mostly commercial websites of UVC vendors, peer-reviewed papers, press releases on UVC research, and public health and regulatory agencies such as the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). We found that the public health and regulatory agencies have much room for improvement in the clarity, actionability, and integration with each other of their messaging and information. The lack of public policy and concerns about safety of UVC may be inhibiting clear and definitive public health messaging. Easily searchable UVC messaging on credible public health and regulatory websites has the potential to translate the peer-reviewed literature for lay audiences and improve public understanding of UVC for reducing airborne infections. In conclusion, this baseline analysis suggests a policy-communication gap in public-facing information about UVC for airborne infection prevention. More integrated, clear, and actionable guidance from neutral, authoritative organizations may support public understanding, informed discussion, and appropriate use of this potentially life-saving approach to protecting people in indoor spaces.

papers.title_zh: 用于预防空气传播感染的紫外线 C 光:基于网络的公共信息的基线分析。
papers.source_body_en: Ultraviolet-C (UVC) technology to mitigate airborne infections was first demonstrated in laboratory and epidemiologic studies of influenza and measles in the 1930s, with effectiveness against tuberculosis demonstrated in the 1950s and again in the early 2000s. Yet, UVC was underutilized during the SARS CoV-2 pandemic (COVID-19). Availability, clarity, and actionability of information and messaging on UVC technology may have played a role in limiting policy discussions and uptake of UVC during the COVID-19 pandemic. The purpose of this analysis was to systematically assess the availability, clarity, and actionability of web-based information about UVC for preventing airborne respiratory infections. Student research assistants conducted internet searches using the Google Search engine after receiving a brief orientation to germicidal ultraviolet (GUV) air disinfection. They referred webpages from public health and regulatory organizations whose missions were to regulate UVC or provide recommendations for UVC to prevent transmission of airborne infectious pathogens to the principal investigator (PI). The PI determined whether the webpages met the inclusion criteria. The PI and a doctoral student with experience and training scored the final sample using the CDC's Clear Communication Index (CCI) which assessed public health information on clarity and actionability across four domains. Searches using the Google Search engine for information targeted to the general public yielded mostly commercial websites of UVC vendors, peer-reviewed papers, press releases on UVC research, and public health and regulatory agencies such as the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). We found that the public health and regulatory agencies have much room for improvement in the clarity, actionability, and integration with each other of their messaging and information. The lack of public policy and concerns about safety of UVC may be inhibiting clear and definitive public health messaging. Easily searchable UVC messaging on credible public health and regulatory websites has the potential to translate the peer-reviewed literature for lay audiences and improve public understanding of UVC for reducing airborne infections. In conclusion, this baseline analysis suggests a policy-communication gap in public-facing information about UVC for airborne infection prevention. More integrated, clear, and actionable guidance from neutral, authoritative organizations may support public understanding, informed discussion, and appropriate use of this potentially life-saving approach to protecting people in indoor spaces.

papers.title: Strengthening India's pandemic preparedness with the four zonal institutes of virology: stakeholder consultations for outbreak response and collaborative research priorities.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM) scheme, supported by the World Bank, is establishing four zonal National Institutes of Virology (NIVs) in India. It is essential to identify the zonal disease and research priorities so as to focus research at zonal levels. This study reports a zonal viral disease prioritisation exercise to support outbreak response and collaborative research. It describes zonal-prioritised viral diseases, assesses concordance and differences in zonal priority lists and, and identifies cross‐cutting research themes and preparedness gaps using an multicriteria decision analysis (MCDA)‐based consensus process. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional, multi-stakeholder consultative study across four geographical zones of India in March 2024. The zonal-level consultative workshops employed a systematic consensus-building approach using the modified One Health Zoonotic Disease Prioritisation (OHZDP) tool, adapted for emerging viral diseases and applied via MCDA. We identified zonal-level stakeholders, listed 40 viral diseases and categorised them into three groups: common occurrence (Group A), limited occurrence (Group B), and rare occurrences with a chance of emergence, evolution or importation (Group C). The stakeholders from state health departments, medical colleges, research institutes and the Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratory (VRDL) network ranked the viral diseases and research themes in each zone. Spearman rank correlation was used to assess concordance of priority rankings between zones. RESULTS: A total of 186 participants (42-48 per zone) contributed to the four zonal workshops including collaborators from VRDL laboratories (26%), public health stakeholders from Integrated Disease Surveillance programme(IDSP) (28%), invited experts (21%), organisers (19%) and Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) representatives (6%). The key outcomes included the zone-specific lists of priority viral diseases in Groups A, B and C. There were zonal variations in viral disease prioritisation, reflecting local epidemiological patterns. Spearman rank correlation analysis showed moderate positive correlation between the Central and East zones (rho = 0.697, P = 0.031), whereas other pairwise comparisons were not statistically significant, which indicated both shared and distinct priority patterns within the zones. The top five priority viral diseases across zones included dengue, influenza, measles, Japanese encephalitis and hepatitis A. The research themes and subthemes were then decided for collaborative research. CONCLUSIONS: These multistakeholder consultations provided a novel, replicable template for prioritising viral diseases to develop strategies for mitigating the impact of future outbreaks through collaborative research. These zonal priorities may guide similar exercises at national, regional and global levels in future.

papers.abstract_original: BACKGROUND: The Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM) scheme, supported by the World Bank, is establishing four zonal National Institutes of Virology (NIVs) in India. It is essential to identify the zonal disease and research priorities so as to focus research at zonal levels. This study reports a zonal viral disease prioritisation exercise to support outbreak response and collaborative research. It describes zonal-prioritised viral diseases, assesses concordance and differences in zonal priority lists and, and identifies cross‐cutting research themes and preparedness gaps using an multicriteria decision analysis (MCDA)‐based consensus process. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional, multi-stakeholder consultative study across four geographical zones of India in March 2024. The zonal-level consultative workshops employed a systematic consensus-building approach using the modified One Health Zoonotic Disease Prioritisation (OHZDP) tool, adapted for emerging viral diseases and applied via MCDA. We identified zonal-level stakeholders, listed 40 viral diseases and categorised them into three groups: common occurrence (Group A), limited occurrence (Group B), and rare occurrences with a chance of emergence, evolution or importation (Group C). papers.abstract_zh: 背景:由世界银行支持的 Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat 卫生基础设施任务 (PM-ABHIM) 计划正在印度建立四个区域性国家病毒学研究所 (NIV)。确定区域疾病和研究重点至关重要,以便将研究重点放在区域层面。本研究报告了一项区域性病毒性疾病优先排序活动,以支持 暴发 响应和协作研究。它描述了区域优先的病毒性疾病,评估区域优先列表的一致性和差异,并使用基于多标准决策分析(MCDA)的共识过程确定跨领域的研究主题和准备差距。方法:我们于 2024 年 3 月在印度的四个地理区域开展了一项横断面、多利益相关者协商研究。区域级协商研讨会采用了系统性的共识建立方法,使用了修改后的 One Health 人畜共患疾病优先排序 (OHZDP) 工具,该工具适用于新出现的病毒性疾病,并通过 MCDA 应用。我们确定了区域级利益相关者,列出了 40 种病毒性疾病,并将其分为三组:常见发生(A 组)、有限发生(B 组)和有机会出现、进化 或输入的罕见发生(C 组)。来自州卫生部门、医学院、研究机构和病毒研究与诊断实验室(VRDL)网络的利益相关者对每个区域的病毒性疾病和研究主题进行了排名。斯皮尔曼排名相关性用于评估区域之间优先级排名的一致性。结果:共有 186 名参与者(每个区域 42-48 人)参与了四个区域研讨会,其中包括 VRDL 实验室的合作者 (26%)、综合疾病 监测 计划 (IDSP) 的公共卫生利益相关者 (28%)、特邀专家 (21%)、组织者 (19%) 和印度医学研究委员会 (ICMR) 代表 (6%)。主要成果包括 A、B 和 C 组中特定区域的优先病毒性疾病清单。病毒性疾病优先顺序存在区域差异,反映了当地的流行病学模式。Spearman 等级相关分析显示中部和东部区域之间呈中度正相关(rho = 0.697,P = 0.031),而其他成对比较没有统计显着性,这表明区域内既有共同的又有不同的优先模式。各地区排名前五位的重点病毒性疾病包括登革热、流感、麻疹、日本脑炎和甲型肝炎。然后确定合作研究的研究主题和副主题。结论:这些多利益相关方磋商提供了一个新颖的、可复制的模板,用于优先考虑病毒性疾病,以制定通过合作研究减轻未来 暴发 影响的策略。这些区域优先事项可能会指导未来在国家、区域和全球层面的类似活动。

papers.title: Childhood immunisation coverage in rural and a tribal settings in southern India and assessing effect of the Covid19 pandemic
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Purpose Childhood immunisation witnessed reduced coverage and delays globally during the Covid19 pandemic. This study aimed to identify gaps in routine childhood immunisation in southern India and the effect of the pandemic in censused rural and tribal populations. Methods This study was conducted between August and September 2021 in a hard-to-reach tribal block (Jawadhu Hills) and rural (Timiri) block in Tamil Nadu. The proportion of full immunisation coverage (FIC), age-appropriate coverage and vaccination delays were calculated in the pre-pandemic (prior to March 2020) and pandemic (lockdown) period. Results Among 2746 children (aged <30 months, with immunisation cards available) surveyed in these populations, overall FIC among children between 12-23 months of age was 50.8% (95%CI: 46.6-55.0) in Jawadhu and 83.7%; (81.1-86.2) in Timiri. In Jawadhu, coverage of oral polio vaccine3 (OPV3) decreased from 78.3% (73.4-82.6) pre-pandemic to 70.0% (66.6-73.2) during the pandemic; inactivated polio vaccine2 (IPV2) from 76.9% (72.1-81.2) to 69.1% (65.5-72.4); Pentavalent3 from 78.0% (73.1-82.4) to 70.2% (66.8-73.5); and Measles containing vaccine1 (MCV1) from 74.6% (67.6-80.8) to 56.7% (53.3-60.1). In Timiri, only MCV1 coverage decreased from 92.9% (88.7-95.9) to 85.4% (83.3-87.3). Factors associated with not receiving MCV1 included due date of vaccination falling during the pandemic lock downs, higher birth order, younger and less educated parents, and residing in the tribal block. Conclusion This study highlighted differences in routine childhood immunisation vaccine coverage and impact of the pandemic in a geographically remote tribal block in contrast to a more accessible, rural block. Resilient health systems are essential to ensure sustainability in gains in vaccination coverage, especially in remote areas, and should be part of pandemic preparedness.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review examines childhood immunisation coverage in rural and tribal settings in southern India, specifically assessing the impact of the Covid-19 pandemic on routine vaccination services.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A cross-sectional study conducted between August and September 2021 in two blocks: Jawadhu Hills (tribal) and Timiri (rural) in Tamil Nadu, involving 2746 children under 30 months with available immunisation cards.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Full immunisation coverage (FIC) was significantly lower in the tribal block (50.8%) compared to the rural block (83.7%). The pandemic led to decreased coverage for multiple vaccines in the tribal area, with MCV1 dropping from 74.6% to 56.7%, while only MCV1 decreased in the rural area (92.9% to 85.4%).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study highlights disparities between tribal and rural populations but does not address long-term consequences of vaccination delays or explore potential solutions for remote areas beyond suggesting resilient health systems.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Resilient health systems are essential to maintain vaccination coverage gains, particularly in remote areas, and should be integrated into pandemic preparedness strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated childhood immunisation coverage in rural and tribal populations in southern India during the Covid-19 pandemic. Findings revealed significant disparities between tribal (50.8% FIC) and rural (83.7% FIC) settings, with the tribal area experiencing substantial declines in multiple vaccine coverages during the pandemic. The research underscores the need for resilient health systems to sustain vaccination progress in remote areas and emphasizes the importance of pandemic preparedness for routine immunisation services.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 在新冠病毒大流行期间,全球儿童免疫接种覆盖率下降且出现延误。这项研究旨在查明印度南部儿童常规免疫接种方面的差距以及该流行病对人口普查的农村和部落人口的影响。方法 这项研究于 2021 年 8 月至 9 月期间在泰米尔纳德邦一个难以到达的部落街区(贾瓦杜山)和农村街区(蒂米里)进行。完全免疫覆盖率(FIC)、适龄覆盖率和疫苗接种延迟的比例是在大流行前(2020年3月之前)和大流行(封锁)期间计算的。结果 在这些人群中接受调查的 2746 名儿童(年龄 <30 月龄,有免疫卡)中,12-23 月龄儿童的总体 FIC 在贾瓦杜为 50.8%(95%CI:46.6-55.0),在贾瓦杜为 83.7%;(81.1-86.2)在蒂米里。在贾瓦杜,口服脊髓灰质炎疫苗3 (OPV3) 的覆盖率从大流行前的 78.3% (73.4-82.6) 下降到大流行期间的 70.0% (66.6-73.2);灭活脊髓灰质炎疫苗2(IPV2)从76.9%(72.1-81.2)降至69.1%(65.5-72.4);五价3从 78.0% (73.1-82.4) 降至 70.2% (66.8-73.5);和麻疹含有疫苗1(MCV1)从74.6%(67.6-80.8)到56.7%(53.3-60.1)。在 Timiri,仅 MCV1 覆盖率从 92.9% (88.7-95.9) 下降至 85.4% (83.3-87.3)。与未接受 MCV1 相关的因素包括 疫苗接种 的预产期在大流行封锁期间下降、出生顺序较高、父母年轻且受教育程度较低以及居住在部落街区。结论 本研究强调了地理偏远部落地区与更容易到达的农村地区常规儿童免疫 疫苗 覆盖率和大流行影响的差异。具有复原力的卫生系统对于确保 疫苗接种 覆盖范围收益的可持续性至关重要,特别是在偏远地区,并且应该成为大流行病防范的一部分。

papers.title: Seroprotection Against Mumps in MMR Vaccinated Children Aged 9-12 Years: A Cross-Sectional Study.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To estimate the proportion of children aged 9-12 years with seroprotective antibody titers against mumps following a single dose of measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine administered in early childhood, and to explore the association between seroprotection and clinicodemographic profile. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted at a tertiary hospital in Delhi between April 2024 and August 2025. Children aged 9-12 years with a documented receipt of a single dose of MMR vaccine at 16-24 months of age were recruited. Two mL of venous blood was collected and analyzed for serum mumps-specific IgG antibodies using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), with seroprotection defined as mumps antibody titers ≥ 22 RU/mL. The association between seroprotection and demographic and clinical variables, including age, sex, age at vaccination, and nutritional status, was assessed using the chi-square test or Fisher's exact test. RESULTS: Eighty-six children (48% males) aged 9-12 years [mean (SD) 10.35 (1.04) years] were enrolled. Overall, 84.8% demonstrated seroprotective antibody titers against mumps. The median (q1, q3) mumps-specific IgG titer was 97.6 (46.1, 144.9) RU/mL. Children aged > 10 years were significantly more likely to be seronegative compared to younger children (OR 3.99, 95% CI 1.07, 14.92, P = 0.039). CONCLUSION: Nearly 85% of children who had received a single MMR dose at 16-24 months of age had seroprotective mumps antibody titers at 9-12 years. The findings highlight the need for larger community-based studies on the durability of mumps immunity and add to the accumulating evidence informing future MMR vaccination strategies in India.

papers.title: Association Between First MMR Vaccination Before Age 2 Years and Childhood Autism in a U.S. EHR Cohort of 2.5 Million Children.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Concerns about potential associations between measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination and autism persist despite extensive prior research. Observational studies evaluating vaccine timing are susceptible to bias from healthcare utilization patterns, neurodevelopmental concerns and time-dependent exposure classification. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the Cosmos electronic health record database, including 2,560,035 US children with linked birth-parent data and follow-up through age 8 years. To minimize bias related to exposure timing and healthcare utilization, we performed prespecified age-based landmark analyses evaluating the first MMR vaccination administered between 11.5 and 24 months. Adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs) for autism were estimated using Cox proportional hazards models with covariates selected via directed acyclic graphs. A negative control exposure (pneumococcal conjugate vaccine booster administered at 12-15 months) was analyzed to assess residual confounding. RESULTS: In the primary 11.5-24 month landmark cohort, the first MMR vaccination was not associated with increased autism risk (aHR 0.97; 99% confidence interval 0.91-1.03). Across all age-specific landmark cohorts, aHRs remained near the null. The negative control analysis yielded a similarly near-null estimate (aHR 1.01; 99% confidence interval 0.99-1.04), supporting that residual bias is unlikely to explain the findings. CONCLUSIONS: In this large US cohort, age-anchored landmark analyses show no association between MMR vaccination before 24 months and childhood autism. The concordant near-null findings for both MMR and a negative control exposure support that the observed results are unlikely to be explained by residual confounding. These findings highlight the importance of age-specific analytic approaches in evaluating vaccine safety using observational data.

papers.title_zh: Association Between First MMR Vaccination Before Age 2 Years and Childhood Autism in a U.S. EHR Cohort of 2.5 Million Children.
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Concerns about potential associations between measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination and autism persist despite extensive prior research. Observational studies evaluating vaccine timing are susceptible to bias from healthcare utilization patterns, neurodevelopmental concerns and time-dependent exposure classification. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the Cosmos electronic health record database, including 2,560,035 US children with linked birth-parent data and follow-up through age 8 years. To minimize bias related to exposure timing and healthcare utilization, we performed prespecified age-based landmark analyses evaluating the first MMR vaccination administered between 11.5 and 24 months. Adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs) for autism were estimated using Cox proportional hazards models with covariates selected via directed acyclic graphs. A negative control exposure (pneumococcal conjugate vaccine booster administered at 12-15 months) was analyzed to assess residual confounding. RESULTS: In the primary 11.5-24 month landmark cohort, the first MMR vaccination was not associated with increased autism risk (aHR 0.97; 99% confidence interval 0.91-1.03). Across all age-specific landmark cohorts, aHRs remained near the null. The negative control analysis yielded a similarly near-null estimate (aHR 1.01; 99% confidence interval 0.99-1.04), supporting that residual bias is unlikely to explain the findings. CONCLUSIONS: In this large US cohort, age-anchored landmark analyses show no association between MMR vaccination before 24 months and childhood autism. The concordant near-null findings for both MMR and a negative control exposure support that the observed results are unlikely to be explained by residual confounding. These findings highlight the importance of age-specific analytic approaches in evaluating vaccine safety using observational data.

papers.title: In silico clinical trials of BiTE expression by oncolytic viruses reveal the impact of patient heterogeneity on dosage protocol.
papers.abstract: Immunotherapies have become a transformative therapeutic strategy for many cancer types in recent years. Bispecific T-cell engagers (BiTEs) are one promising immunotherapy that enhances cellular antitumour immunity by redirecting T cells towards cancer cells. Recent evidence suggests that BiTE efficacy can be augmented by encoding BiTEs in oncolytic measles virus vectors (MV-BiTE). Infection of cancer cells with MV-BiTE causes the local production of BiTEs and has shown safety and efficacy in murine tumour models. However, whether the observed efficacy of this treatment will translate to a heterogeneous human population is unknown. In this work, we generate an in silico clinical trial of MV-BiTE therapy using a system of ordinary differential equations. We capture potential heterogeneity of individual patients using variability in in vivo tumour volume and change in baseline (%) measurements from a Phase II clinical trial. In lieu of human MV-BiTE data, we use the oncolytic virus talimogene laherparepvec (T-VEC) as a surrogate oncolytic virus carrying an immunostimulatory payload. Our predictions imply that the main drivers of heterogeneity are the underlying effector T cell killing rate and BiTE pharmacokinetics. Furthermore, we find that if individuals are classified as non-responders to the Phase II T-VEC clinical protocol, they may respond to more frequent administration of lower dosages. This work highlights how in silico clinical trials can provide predictions for novel therapeutics to generate hypotheses and guide the design of treatment schedules for clinical translation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to determine whether the efficacy of MV-BiTE therapy observed in murine tumour models would translate to a heterogeneous human population, addressing a critical knowledge gap in clinical translation.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An in silico clinical trial was conducted using a system of ordinary differential equations to model patient heterogeneity based on tumour volume and baseline measurements from a Phase II clinical trial.
analysis.methods: The researchers generated an in silico clinical trial using ordinary differential equations and incorporated patient heterogeneity by varying tumour volume and baseline measurements, using T-VEC as a surrogate oncolytic virus.
analysis.main_results: The predictions identified effector T cell killing rate and BiTE pharmacokinetics as main drivers of heterogeneity, and suggested that non-responders to the Phase II T-VEC protocol may respond to more frequent administration of lower dosages.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that in silico clinical trials can provide predictions for novel therapeutics to generate hypotheses and guide treatment schedules for clinical translation, highlighting the novelty of this approach.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the design of personalized treatment schedules for MV-BiTE therapy, potentially improving efficacy in heterogeneous patient populations and advancing the clinical translation of oncolytic virus-based immunotherapies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on surrogate data (T-VEC) and the absence of direct human MV-BiTE data, though the in silico approach allows for systematic exploration of patient heterogeneity.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted an in silico clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy of MV-BiTE therapy in a heterogeneous human population, addressing a critical gap in clinical translation. Using ordinary differential equations and incorporating patient variability from Phase II trial data, the researchers identified T cell killing rate and BiTE pharmacokinetics as key drivers of treatment response. Their findings suggest that non-responders may benefit from more frequent, lower-dose administration, providing a framework for personalized treatment protocols. While the evidence is moderate due to reliance on surrogate data, the approach demonstrates the potential of in silico trials to guide clinical translation of oncolytic virus-based immunotherapies.

papers.title_zh: 溶瘤病毒表达 BiTE 的计算机模拟临床试验揭示了患者异质性对剂量方案的影响。
papers.source_body_en: Immunotherapies have become a transformative therapeutic strategy for many cancer types in recent years. Bispecific T-cell engagers (BiTEs) are one promising immunotherapy that enhances cellular antitumour immunity by redirecting T cells towards cancer cells. Recent evidence suggests that BiTE efficacy can be augmented by encoding BiTEs in oncolytic measles virus vectors (MV-BiTE). Infection of cancer cells with MV-BiTE causes the local production of BiTEs and has shown safety and efficacy in murine tumour models. However, whether the observed efficacy of this treatment will translate to a heterogeneous human population is unknown. In this work, we generate an in silico clinical trial of MV-BiTE therapy using a system of ordinary differential equations. We capture potential heterogeneity of individual patients using variability in in vivo tumour volume and change in baseline (%) measurements from a Phase II clinical trial. In lieu of human MV-BiTE data, we use the oncolytic virus talimogene laherparepvec (T-VEC) as a surrogate oncolytic virus carrying an immunostimulatory payload. Our predictions imply that the main drivers of heterogeneity are the underlying effector T cell killing rate and BiTE pharmacokinetics. Furthermore, we find that if individuals are classified as non-responders to the Phase II T-VEC clinical protocol, they may respond to more frequent administration of lower dosages. This work highlights how in silico clinical trials can provide predictions for novel therapeutics to generate hypotheses and guide the design of treatment schedules for clinical translation.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,免疫疗法已成为许多癌症类型的变革性治疗策略。双特异性 T 细胞接合剂 (BiTE) 是一种有前景的免疫疗法,可通过将 T 细胞重新导向癌细胞来增强细胞抗肿瘤免疫力。最近的证据表明,通过在溶瘤 麻疹病毒 媒介 (MV-BiTE) 中编码 BiTE 可以增强 BiTE 功效。用 MV-BiTE 感染癌细胞会导致 BiTE 的局部产生,并在小鼠肿瘤模型中显示出安全性和有效性。然而,观察到的 治疗 功效是否会转化为异质人群尚不清楚。在这项工作中,我们使用常微分方程组进行了 MV-BiTE 疗法的计算机临床试验。我们利用 II 期临床试验中体内肿瘤体积的变化和基线 (%) 测量值的变化来捕获个体患者的潜在异质性。我们使用溶瘤病毒 talimogene laherparepvec (T-VEC) 作为携带免疫刺激有效负载的替代溶瘤病毒来代替人类 MV-BiTE 数据。我们的预测表明异质性的主要驱动因素是潜在的效应 T 细胞杀伤率和 BiTE 药代动力学。此外,我们发现,如果个体被归类为对 II 期 T-VEC 临床方案无反应的人,他们可能会对更频繁、更低剂量的给药产生反应。这项工作强调了计算机临床试验如何为新疗法提供预测,以生成假设并指导 治疗 临床转化时间表的设计。

papers.title: What Is Old Is New Again: Tips and Tricks for Recognizing and Treating Vaccine-Preventable Diseases of Childhood Presenting to the Emergency Department.
papers.abstract: Across the globe, there has been a resurgence in vaccine-preventable diseases reflecting declining immunity, vaccine hesitancy and gaps in vaccine coverage. Vaccination was seen as one of the most successful public health interventions of the 20th century-as a consequence, many vaccine-preventable diseases such as measles and diphtheria were relegated to textbooks. With the re-emergence of vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs), it is an urgent priority to equip emergency physicians with the knowledge to rapidly identify and manage potential cases and strengthen public health measures to curb transmission.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the resurgence of vaccine-preventable diseases globally, which is attributed to declining immunity, vaccine hesitancy, and gaps in vaccine coverage.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on measles virus, measles morbillivirus, and Morbillivirus hominis, with an emphasis on measles disease and subacute sclerosing panencephalitis as related entities.
analysis.methods: The study involved examining the historical context of measles virus and its resurgence, with implications for emergency medicine and public health interventions.
analysis.main_results: The study highlighted the re-emergence of measles virus and related diseases, emphasizing the need for emergency physicians to recognize and manage these conditions effectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the resurgence of measles virus as a call to action for healthcare professionals to enhance their diagnostic and management skills, which is a novel approach in the context of modern public health challenges.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of maintaining vaccination programs and improving emergency department preparedness to address the resurgence of measles virus and related diseases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-level evidence, which may limit the depth of analysis, but the implications are clear and relevant to the topic with a moderate confidence level.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the resurgence of measles virus and related vaccine-preventable diseases, emphasizing the need for emergency physicians to recognize and manage these conditions effectively. It highlights the historical success of vaccination in reducing measles disease and its re-emergence due to declining immunity and vaccine hesitancy. The authors stress the importance of strengthening public health measures and improving diagnostic capabilities in emergency settings. While the evidence is based on abstract-level information, the implications are significant for both clinical practice and public health policy. The study underscores the urgency of maintaining vaccination programs and enhancing emergency department preparedness to combat the resurgence of measles virus. However, the abstract-only nature of the evidence limits the depth of analysis, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

papers.title: Digital Health Communication Collapse: Public Trust, Vaccine Shortages, and the Shutdown of the Surokkha App
papers.abstract: Abstract The introduction of digital health platforms during the COVID-19 pandemic was a significant step toward improving public health governance, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. The Surokkha App was one of the digital tools used in Bangladesh to facilitate the COVID-19 vaccination campaign. It allowed registering appointments, obtaining vaccination certificates, and providing essential health information. However, the tool was discontinued amid reports of a shortage of routine childhood vaccines, including measles, which triggered widespread confusion and mistrust among the public. This study aims to determine how the discontinuation of the digital tool and the shortage of conventional vaccines undermined the government’s ability to communicate effectively and restore confidence. The study examines the crisis through the lens of digital governance, risk communication, and policy implementation. It evaluates policy documents, experts’ opinions, and media reports on the issue to identify the critical areas of concern. The findings reveal that the crisis was caused by inadequate digital health governance, poor contingency planning, and ineffective risk communication, which fueled panic and mistrust. The study concludes that effective digital health governance requires institutional coordination, contingency planning, and effective public communication to build trust and ensure sustainable policy outcomes. The lessons learned can help other developing countries navigate similar challenges and transition from emergency to sustainable health governance effectively.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要:在 COVID-19 大流行期间引入数字健康平台是改善公共卫生治理的重要一步,特别是在低收入和中等收入国家。Surokkha 应用程序是孟加拉国用于促进 COVID-19 疫苗接种 活动的数字工具之一。它允许注册预约、获取 疫苗接种 证书并提供基本的健康信息。然而,由于有报道称儿童常规 疫苗(包括 麻疹)短缺,该工具被终止,这引发了公众的广泛困惑和不信任。本研究旨在确定数字工具的停用和传统 疫苗 的短缺如何削弱政府有效沟通和恢复信心的能力。该研究从数字治理、风险沟通和政策实施的角度审视了这场危机。它评估有关该问题的政策文件、专家意见和媒体报道,以确定值得关注的关键领域。调查结果显示,这场危机是由于数字健康治理不足、应急计划不力以及风险沟通不力造成的,从而加剧了恐慌和不信任。该研究的结论是,有效的数字健康治理需要机构协调、应急计划和有效的公众沟通,以建立信任并确保可持续的政策成果。汲取的经验教训可以帮助其他发展中国家应对类似的挑战,并有效地从紧急情况过渡到可持续的卫生治理。

papers.title: Parents’ role as advocates for and against childhood vaccination: Findings from a nationally representative survey
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In 2025, the US recorded the highest number of measles cases in 25 years, signaling an urgent need for renewed attention to increasing childhood vaccination coverage. To identify future intervention partners, we sought to understand parents' role in advocating for and against childhood vaccines. METHODS: A nationally representative sample of 1,315 parents of children ages 9-12 years participated in our online survey about vaccine advocacy behaviors in 2025. Separate weighted logistic regression models identified correlates of encouraging or discouraging other parents from getting routine vaccines for their children. RESULTS: Over one-third of parents reported encouraging routine vaccines sometimes or more often (36%), while about one-tenth reported discouraging vaccines (12%). These estimates include a small proportion of parents (6%) who reported both behaviors. Parents with higher confidence in the importance of vaccines for their child's health were more likely to be encouragers and less likely to be discouragers (both p < .05). Encouragers (n = 477) most often advocated for measles (50%) or seasonal flu vaccines (44%). These parents most often engaged family members and close friends, using strategies such as sharing vaccine experiences (47%), information about vaccine effectiveness (38%), and advice or opinions about vaccines (35%). Discouragers (n = 151) most often advocated against Covid-19 (53%) or seasonal flu vaccines (41%), with relatively few focusing on measles vaccine (10%). Discouragers engaged similar audiences and strategies as encouragers. CONCLUSION: Findings of our nationally representative study suggest that parents who encourage routine vaccination far outnumber those who discourage it. Given that encouragers often advocate for measles vaccine, future efforts to increase vaccination coverage should consider ways to partner with parent advocates to stem the alarming resurgence of this disease.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2025 年,美国记录了 25 年来最高的 麻疹 病例数,这表明迫切需要重新关注增加儿童 麻疹 覆盖率。本研究旨在了解父母在支持和反对儿童 疫苗 方面的角色,以确定未来的干预合作伙伴。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025 年,全国有代表性的 1,315 名 9-12 岁儿童家长参与了一项关于 疫苗 倡导行为的在线调查。该研究重点关注家长对 麻疹 疫苗 的行为,这是鼓励者最常倡导的。
elements_zh.methods: 单独的加权逻辑回归模型确定了鼓励或阻止其他父母为孩子进行常规 疫苗 的相关性。分析包括检查家长在宣传工作中使用的策略和受众。
elements_zh.main_results: 超过三分之一的家长表示有时或更频繁地鼓励常规 疫苗 (36%),而约十分之一的家长则表示不鼓励 疫苗 (12%)。这些估计包括一小部分报告这两种行为的父母 (6%)。

papers.title_zh: 父母作为儿童支持者和反对者的角色 疫苗接种:全国代表性调查的结果
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: In 2025, the US recorded the highest number of measles cases in 25 years, signaling an urgent need for renewed attention to increasing childhood vaccination coverage. To identify future intervention partners, we sought to understand parents' role in advocating for and against childhood vaccines. METHODS: A nationally representative sample of 1,315 parents of children ages 9-12 years participated in our online survey about vaccine advocacy behaviors in 2025. Separate weighted logistic regression models identified correlates of encouraging or discouraging other parents from getting routine vaccines for their children. RESULTS: Over one-third of parents reported encouraging routine vaccines sometimes or more often (36%), while about one-tenth reported discouraging vaccines (12%). These estimates include a small proportion of parents (6%) who reported both behaviors. Parents with higher confidence in the importance of vaccines for their child's health were more likely to be encouragers and less likely to be discouragers (both p < .05). Encouragers (n = 477) most often advocated for measles (50%) or seasonal flu vaccines (44%). These parents most often engaged family members and close friends, using strategies such as sharing vaccine experiences (47%), information about vaccine effectiveness (38%), and advice or opinions about vaccines (35%). Discouragers (n = 151) most often advocated against Covid-19 (53%) or seasonal flu vaccines (41%), with relatively few focusing on measles vaccine (10%). Discouragers engaged similar audiences and strategies as encouragers. CONCLUSION: Findings of our nationally representative study suggest that parents who encourage routine vaccination far outnumber those who discourage it. Given that encouragers often advocate for measles vaccine, future efforts to increase vaccination coverage should consider ways to partner with parent advocates to stem the alarming resurgence of this disease.

papers.title: Analysis of Communicable Disease Trends in Children: Babylon Governorate, Iraq from 2022 to 2024
papers.abstract: Background: Infectious diseases are a great challenge to the health of children globally. This paper provides an epidemiological scenario and patterns of these diseases among children in the Hilla Babylon Governorate, Iraq, and specifically, the re-emergence of meals. Methods: The retrospective study was carried out on 7851 medical records of children aged below 15 years between the period of January 1, 2022 and December 31, 2024. The registry of Babylon Maternity and Children Hospital was used to extract data. Data were analyzed in terms of trends and distributions by age, sex and time using descriptive statistics and inferential tests. Results: Droplet and airborne mode of infection were responsible of a huge percentage (89.1, n=6998). The most common one was pneumonia (59.3, n=4659), and then measles (21.0, n=1651). The dramatic resurgence of measles was recorded, and in 2022, there were zero cases, and in 2023, the rates were 344 and in 2024, 1,307. Foodborne infections 10.1% (n=795) were mainly hepatitis A (98.4% of foodborne infections). Significant differences in the age and sex distributions of particular diseases were found to be statistically significant. Younger children (years) had more pneumonia, pertussis, and viral meningitis whereas older children (5-9 years) had Hepatitis A. Pneumonia and viral meningitis had a high male predominance whereas pertussis was more prevalent in females. Conclusion: Respiratory-borne diseases and especially pneumonia and measles have the greatest burden of communicable disease among children in this region. The disastrous revival of measles points to the existence of severe gaps in immunization coverage and preparedness to the outbreaks. The interventions in the field of public health should be focused on the reinforcement of a routine and catch-up vaccination campaign, the improvement of respiratory infections control, and the improvement of sanitation and hygiene measures directed at high-risk age groups.

Data were analyzed in terms of trends and distributions by age, sex and time using descriptive statistics and inferential tests. Results: Droplet and airborne mode of infection were responsible of a huge percentage (89.1, n=6998). The most common one was pneumonia (59.3, n=4659), and then measles (21.0, n=1651). The dramatic resurgence of measles was recorded, and in 2022, there were zero cases, and in 2023, the rates were 344 and in 2024, 1,307. Foodborne infections 10.1% (n=795) were mainly hepatitis A (98.4% of foodborne infections). Significant differences in the age and sex distributions of particular diseases were found to be statistically significant. Younger children (years) had more pneumonia, pertussis, and viral meningitis whereas older children (5-9 years) had Hepatitis A. Pneumonia and viral meningitis had a high male predominance whereas pertussis was more prevalent in females. Conclusion: Respiratory-borne diseases and especially pneumonia and measles have the greatest burden of communicable disease among children in this region. The disastrous revival of measles points to the existence of severe gaps in immunization coverage and preparedness to the outbreaks. The interventions in the field of public health should be focused on the reinforcement of a routine and catch-up vaccination campaign, the improvement of respiratory infections control, and the improvement of sanitation and hygiene measures directed at high-risk age groups.

papers.title: Prepared or at-risk? Evaluating live viral vaccine coverage and vaccine immunogenicity before pediatric solid organ transplantation
papers.abstract: Pediatric solid organ transplant recipients are at high risk for complications from vaccine-preventable diseases, yet pre-transplant vaccination coverage is often inconsistent. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 421 pediatric transplant recipients between 2018 and 2024 to evaluate vaccination status and serologic immunity for varicella and measles at the time of initial evaluation, listing, and transplantation. At the time of transplant, 19.2% of patients for varicella and 21.6% for measles were under-vaccinated, with infants having the highest rates of incomplete vaccination. A portion of patients (7.1% for varicella, 8.6% for measles) transitioned from full to incomplete vaccination status during the pre-transplant period, a change associated with a shorter time from evaluation to listing. Kidney recipients had the highest completed vaccination rates (>94%), whereas rates for liver and heart recipients were substantially lower (58%–72%). Among fully vaccinated patients, seronegativity was observed for varicella (23.6%) and measles (13.0%). In conclusion, many pediatric transplant candidates, particularly infants and those awaiting liver or heart transplant, are incompletely vaccinated. A dynamic change in vaccination status from evaluation to transplant highlights an urgent need for continuous monitoring and improved strategies to protect these vulnerable children.

papers.title: Tissue-directed maintenance of human B-cell memory after vaccination and infection 2260241
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Vaccines differ in their efficacy and durability of protection. Clinical titer studies show that some, e.g. measles, confer lifelong immunity, while others wane within months or years. The memory B cells (MBCs) that sustain these responses reside mainly in lymphoid tissues, but it remains unclear whether these compartments maintain distinct subsets, how they contribute to vaccine immunity, and how they vary with age or antigen. Methods We profiled four ag-specific MBC populations, specific for childhood vaccines measles and tetanus and ubiquitous viruses SARS-CoV-2 and H1N1 influenza, across paired blood, spleen, lymph nodes, and bone marrow, by flow cytometry and paired single-cell RNA and B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing. Results MBC isotype, subset, and phenotype differed markedly between tissue sites, specificity, and age. Lymph nodes were reservoirs for classical IgG+ memory with high expression of the residency marker CD69. In other sites, whereas measles retained a classical phenotype, tetanus MBCs were enriched for non-switched memory. Notably, SARS-CoV-2 and influenza responses were highly switched but, with age, uniquely accumulated hyporesponsive CD27- CD21- atypical memory in the blood, bone marrow, and spleen. RNA sequencing resolved three core MBC subsets enriched in distinct tissues: tissue-adapted classical MBCs in lymph nodes, marginal zone—like MBCs in spleen, and atypical MBCs in bone marrow. All three subsets were represented within ag-specific populations, but their relative proportions were shaped by both tissue and antigen. Clonal and phylogenetic analyses revealed that expanded ag-specific clones, including cells with identical BCRs, spanned multiple subsets, indicating that MBC identity is flexible but primarily shaped by local context rather than lineage. Conclusion This work uncovers functionally distinct tissue reservoirs of vaccine and infection-induced memory and the host and antigen factors that shape them, highlighting new opportunities for vaccine design. Funding Source NIH U19 AI128949, DARPA Topic Categories Lymphocyte Differentiation and Peripheral Maintenance (LYM)

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how memory B cells (MBCs) are maintained in different tissues after vaccination and infection, particularly focusing on whether distinct subsets exist in lymphoid tissues and how they contribute to vaccine immunity, vary with age, or differ by antigen.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study profiled antigen-specific MBC populations for childhood vaccines (measles and tetanus) and ubiquitous viruses (SARS-CoV-2 and H1N1 influenza) across paired blood, spleen, lymph nodes, and bone marrow samples.
analysis.methods: Researchers used flow cytometry and paired single-cell RNA and B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing to analyze MBC populations, with RNA sequencing resolving three core MBC subsets enriched in distinct tissues.
analysis.main_results: MBC isotype, subset, and phenotype differed markedly between tissue sites, specificity, and age; lymph nodes were reservoirs for classical IgG+ memory with high CD69 expression; and expanded antigen-specific clones spanned multiple subsets, indicating flexible MBC identity shaped by local context.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as uncovering functionally distinct tissue reservoirs of vaccine and infection-induced memory, shaped by host and antigen factors, highlighting new opportunities for vaccine design.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform vaccine design by revealing how tissue-specific memory B cell maintenance varies by antigen and age, potentially guiding strategies to enhance durable immunity.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence strength is high, as it comprehensively profiled multiple tissues and antigens using advanced sequencing, though limitations include potential generalizability beyond the studied populations and antigens.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated tissue-directed maintenance of human B-cell memory after vaccination and infection, focusing on measles, tetanus, SARS-CoV-2, and H1N1 influenza. Researchers found that memory B cell subsets, isotypes, and phenotypes varied significantly by tissue site, antigen specificity, and age. Lymph nodes served as reservoirs for classical IgG+ memory with high CD69 expression, while other sites showed distinct patterns, such as non-switched memory for tetanus and atypical memory for SARS-CoV-2 and influenza with age. RNA sequencing identified three core MBC subsets enriched in different tissues, and clonal analyses revealed that expanded antigen-specific clones spanned multiple subsets, indicating flexible identity shaped by local context. The findings highlight functionally distinct tissue reservoirs and their shaping factors, offering new insights for vaccine design.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解记忆 B 细胞 (MBC) 在 疫苗接种 和感染后如何在不同组织中维持,特别关注淋巴组织中是否存在不同的亚群,以及它们如何促进 疫苗 免疫,随年龄变化或因抗原而异。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了配对血液、脾脏、淋巴结和骨髓样本中儿童 疫苗(麻疹 和破伤风)和普遍存在的病毒(SARS-CoV-2 和 H1N1 流感)的抗原特异性 MBC 群体。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用流式细胞术和配对单细胞 RNA 和 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 测序来分析 MBC 群体,其中 RNA 测序解析了不同组织中富集的三个核心 MBC 亚群。
elements_zh.main_results: MBC 同种型、亚型和表型在组织部位、特异性和年龄之间存在显着差异;淋巴结为 储存宿主,代表经典 IgG+ 记忆,CD69 高表达;扩展的抗原特异性克隆跨越多个子集,表明由当地环境决定的灵活的 MBC 身份。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为揭示了 疫苗 的功能上不同的组织 储存宿主 和感染诱导的记忆,由 宿主 和抗原因子塑造,突出了 疫苗 设计的新机会。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现通过揭示组织特异性记忆 B 细胞维持如何随抗原和年龄而变化,为 疫苗 设计提供信息,从而可能指导增强持久免疫力的策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据强度很高,因为它使用高级测序全面分析了多种组织和抗原,但其局限性包括超出研究人群和抗原的潜在普遍性。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 疫苗 的保护功效和持久性各不相同。临床滴度研究表明,一些,例如麻疹 赋予终生免疫力,而其他免疫力则在数月或数年内减弱。维持这些反应的记忆 B 细胞 (MBC) 主要存在于淋巴组织中,但目前尚不清楚这些区室是否维持不同的子集、它们如何促进 疫苗 免疫、以及它们如何随年龄或抗原而变化。方法 我们通过流式细胞术和配对单细胞 RNA 和 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 测序,对配对血液、脾脏、淋巴结和骨髓中的四种 Ag 特异性 MBC 群体进行了分析,这些群体针对儿童 疫苗 麻疹 和破伤风以及普遍存在的病毒 SARS-CoV-2 和 H1N1 流感。结果 MBC 同种型、亚型和表型在组织部位、特异性和年龄之间存在显着差异。淋巴结为 储存宿主,代表经典 IgG+ 记忆,高表达驻留标记 CD69。在其他位点,虽然 麻疹 保留了经典表型,但破伤风 MBC 的非转换记忆得到了丰富。值得注意的是,SARS-CoV-2 和流感反应高度不同,但随着年龄的增长,血液、骨髓和脾脏中独特地积累了低反应性 CD27-CD21-非典型记忆。RNA测序解析了在不同组织中富集的三个核心MBC亚群:淋巴结中的组织适应经典MBC、脾中的边缘区样MBC和骨髓中的非典型MBC。所有三个亚群都代表抗原特异性群体,但它们的相对比例由组织和抗原决定。克隆和系统发育分析表明,扩大的 Ag 特异性克隆(包括具有相同 BCR 的细胞)跨越多个子集,这表明 MBC 身份是灵活的,但主要由局部环境而不是谱系决定。结论 这项工作揭示了 疫苗 的功能上不同的组织 储存宿主 和感染诱导的记忆以及 宿主 和塑造它们的抗原因子,突出了 疫苗 设计的新机会。资金来源 NIH U19 AI128949、DARPA 主题类别 淋巴细胞分化和外周维护 (LYM)

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解记忆 B 细胞 (MBC) 在 疫苗接种 和感染后如何在不同组织中维持,特别关注淋巴组织中是否存在不同的亚群,以及它们如何促进 疫苗 免疫,随年龄变化或因抗原而异。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了配对血液、脾脏、淋巴结和骨髓样本中儿童 疫苗(麻疹 和破伤风)和普遍存在的病毒(SARS-CoV-2 和 H1N1 流感)的抗原特异性 MBC 群体。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员使用流式细胞术和配对单细胞 RNA 和 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 测序来分析 MBC 群体,其中 RNA 测序解析了不同组织中富集的三个核心 MBC 亚群。
analysis_zh.main_results: MBC 同种型、亚型和表型在组织部位、特异性和年龄之间存在显着差异;淋巴结为 储存宿主,代表经典 IgG+ 记忆,CD69 高表达;扩展的抗原特异性克隆跨越多个子集,表明由当地环境决定的灵活的 MBC 身份。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为揭示了 疫苗 的功能上不同的组织 储存宿主 和感染诱导的记忆,由 宿主 和抗原因子塑造,突出了 疫苗 设计的新机会。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现通过揭示组织特异性记忆 B 细胞维持如何随抗原和年龄而变化,为 疫苗 设计提供信息,从而可能指导增强持久免疫力的策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据强度很高,因为它使用高级测序全面分析了多种组织和抗原,但其局限性包括超出研究人群和抗原的潜在普遍性。

papers.title: Computational design of immunogenic peptide–ligand conjugates for targeted therapy against Nipah virus infection
papers.abstract: Introduction Nipah virus (NiV) poses a major risk to global public health due to its high infectivity and associated mortality rates. Currently, no licensed vaccines or antiviral medications are available for NiV infection, leaving clinical management limited to supportive care. The viral receptor glycoprotein responsible for binding NiV to host cell receptors (ephrin-B2/B3) represents an ideal therapeutic target. This study proposes a novel peptide-ligand conjugate (PLC) immunotherapeutic approach that exploits pre-existing immune responses in NiV-endemic populations to selectively target and eliminate infected cells. Methods We employed biomolecular modeling ( in silico ) to establish binding affinities and perform docking studies using a compound library obtained from the MolProphet database. A non-cleavable oxime linker was selected to enhance physical stability and ensure robust conjugation between ligand and peptide components. The peptide was engineered to contain immunogenic minimal epitope regions derived from measles, mumps, and rubella vaccines, selected based on their high immunization rates and long-lived memory responses in individuals residing in NiV-endemic areas. Results The PLC design demonstrated selective binding capacity to a transmembrane protein present on NiV-infected cells. The oxime linker provided enhanced stability, and the peptide epitope design successfully incorporated regions associated with established long-term immunity. Discussion This PLC system represents a promising framework for antiviral therapeutic development by harnessing pre-existing immune recognition to promote selective clearance of NiV-infected cells. The findings highlight critical structural components and functional roles of PLCs in therapeutic development, including drug target screening and rational design strategies for enhancing targeting specificity and molecular stability. Future work should focus on experimental validation of the computational predictions and in vitro / in vivo efficacy studies.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a computational approach to design immunogenic peptide–ligand conjugates (PLCs) for targeted therapy against Nipah virus infection. The research is motivated by the lack of licensed vaccines or antiviral medications for NiV, which poses a significant public health risk. The methods involve in silico modeling to identify binding affinities and docking studies, alongside engineering peptides with epitopes from measles, mumps, and rubella vaccines, which are known for their high immunization rates and long-lived memory responses. The main result is the demonstration of selective binding of the PLC to a transmembrane protein on NiV-infected cells. The findings highlight the potential of PLCs in therapeutic development, particularly in drug target screening and rational design strategies. However, the study is limited to computational design and lacks experimental validation, which moderates the confidence in the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在开发一种新型免疫治疗方法来对抗尼帕病毒感染,因为它的高传染性和相关的 死亡率 率对全球公共卫生构成重大风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用计算方法设计肽-配体缀合物(PLC),用于针对尼帕病毒感染的靶向治疗,重点关注可以利用预先存在的 免疫应答 的 NiV 流行人群。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用生物分子模型(计算机)来建立结合亲和力,并与 MolProphet 数据库中的化合物库进行对接研究。他们还对肽进行了改造,使其包含来自 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 疫苗 的免疫原性表位,这些表位是根据其高免疫率和长效记忆反应而选择的。
elements_zh.main_results: PLC 设计证明了对尼帕病毒感染细胞上存在的跨膜蛋白的选择性结合能力。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究将这些发现解释为 抗病毒药物 治疗开发的一个有前途的框架,利用预先存在的免疫识别来促进尼帕病毒感染细胞的选择性清除。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为 PLC 在治疗开发中的结构成分和功能作用提供了重要的见解,这可以为未来增强 抗病毒药物 治疗 的靶向特异性和分子稳定性的策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于计算设计,缺乏实验验证,这使得证据强度降至中等。

papers.title: Vaccine Misconceptions and Healthcare Workers 2306364
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Despite vaccination being one of the most effective public-health interventions, vaccine confidence has recently declined. Widespread misinformation and reduced trust in public health agencies have created challenges for those in healthcare. Perceived gaps in federal communication further complicate clinical and educational information-seeking. As institutional credibility is questioned, healthcare professionals rely on fragmented online sources that amplify uncertainty and misinformation. Polling data show that parents report trusting non-medical influencers (i.e. Joe Rogan, RFK Jr., and the Children’s Defense Fund) for critical children’s health information. The politicization of science underscores the urgent need to strengthen immunology and vaccine literacy education across clinical training and healthcare professionals. Methods We conducted an IRB-approved, anonymous assessment (n = 7711) across those employed in healthcare/science (HCW/S) and non-healthcare workers (NHCW). Results Results showed that although HCW/S generally held more accurate vaccine perceptions than NHCW, misconceptions remained common. For the statement, “There is evidence that the mercury in the measles vaccine can cause autism”, HCW had a lower weighted mean score (1.97 vs. 2.35; n = 7711; p = 0.05). However, 32% still selected strongly agree, agree, or neither agree nor disagree, despite this statement being factually incorrect. Similar analyses were observed across other statements, including 33% of HCW believing the influenza vaccine can cause influenza. Conclusion Vaccine education rooted in core immunologic concepts and communication literacy is critical amid declining trust in traditional public-health authorities. Strengthening immunology curricula, CMEs, CEUs, role playing, discussions, etc. are critical to ensure that healthcare professionals can critically evaluate evidence, identify reliable sources, and counter misinformation to sustain a scientifically informed workforce. Funding Source n/a Topic Categories Immunology Education and Communication (EDU)

papers.title: Karakterisasi transformasi kultur sel ginjal monyet ekor panjang secara molekuler
papers.abstract: Satwa primata memiliki peran penting dalam penelitian biomedis karena memiliki kemiripan genetik dan fisiologis yang erat dengan manusia. Sel ginjal yang ditransformasi bersumber dari monyet ekor panjang (Mf) asal Indonesia telah berhasil dikembangkan untuk tujuan menjadi sel model in vitro dan pengembangan riset vaksin. Sel lestari dengan kualitas yang baik harus memiliki karakteristik yang sama dengan sel induknya. Karakterisasi sel ginjal transformasi Mf belum pernah dilakukan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk karakterisasi molekuler sel ginjal Mf yang dilakukan transformasi dengan mengkarakterisasi keberadaan gen reseptor virus, gen penekan tumor, dan gen proliferasi. Analisis dilakukan terhadap gen CD46 dan CD155 sebagai reseptor virus measles dan polio, gen endosialin, CD24, dan vWF sebagai penanda morfologi sel (fibroblast, epitel, dan endotel), serta gen PCNA dan P53 sebagai penanda proliferasi dan penekan tumor. Keberadaan gen dianalisis melalui teknik PCR. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa gen target dalam studi ini (CD46, CD155, CD24, endosialin, vWF, PCNA, dan P53) berhasil teridentifikasi dalam sel ginjal Mf transformasi, sel Vero dan sel ginjal Mf normal. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa secara molekuler sel ginjal Mf yang ditransformasi menunjukkan karakteristik secara molekuler yang sama dengan sel ginjal Mf normal dan berpotensi sebagai model sel untuk penelitian biomedis sebagai sediaan in vitro untuk pengembangan vaksin.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need for in vitro cell models derived from non-human primates that closely resemble human cells for biomedical research, particularly vaccine development. It highlights the gap in molecular characterization of transformed kidney cells from long-tailed macaques (Macaca fascicularis) from Indonesia.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research characterized transformed kidney cells from long-tailed macaques (Mf) using molecular techniques. The study focused on cells sourced from Indonesian macaques and compared transformed cells with normal kidney cells and Vero cells.
analysis.methods: The presence of target genes was analyzed using PCR to detect measles virus receptors (CD46 and CD155), cell morphology markers (endosialin, CD24, and vWF), and proliferation and tumor suppressor markers (PCNA and P53).
analysis.main_results: All target genes (CD46, CD155, CD24, endosialin, vWF, PCNA, and P53) were successfully identified in the transformed Mf kidney cells, normal Mf kidney cells, and Vero cells.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as evidence that transformed Mf kidney cells retain molecular characteristics similar to normal Mf kidney cells, supporting their potential use as in vitro models for biomedical research and vaccine development. This characterization had not been previously performed.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study suggests that transformed Mf kidney cells could serve as reliable in vitro models for measles virus research and vaccine development, potentially improving preclinical testing and reducing reliance on human-derived cells.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to molecular characterization via PCR and does not include functional assays or direct measles virus infection studies, which weakens the strength of the conclusions. The study is based solely on abstract-level evidence, further reducing confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to characterize transformed kidney cells from long-tailed macaques (Macaca fascicularis) at the molecular level to assess their suitability as in vitro models for biomedical research, particularly vaccine development. Using PCR, the authors detected key genes including measles virus receptors (CD46 and CD155), cell morphology markers (endosialin, CD24, vWF), and proliferation and tumor suppressor markers (PCNA and P53). All target genes were identified in transformed Mf kidney cells, normal Mf kidney cells, and Vero cells, suggesting molecular similarity between transformed and normal cells. The authors conclude that transformed Mf kidney cells could serve as reliable in vitro models for measles virus research and vaccine development. However, the study is limited to molecular characterization without functional validation or direct measles virus infection assays, and the evidence is derived solely from the abstract, reducing the strength of the findings.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用分子技术对长尾猕猴 (Mf) 的转化肾细胞进行了表征。该研究的重点是来自印度尼西亚猕猴的细胞,并将转化细胞与正常肾细胞和 Vero 细胞进行比较。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 PCR 分析靶基因的存在,以检测 麻疹病毒 受体(CD46 和 CD155)、细胞形态标记物(内皮唾液酸蛋白、CD24 和 vWF)以及增殖和肿瘤抑制标记物(PCNA 和 P53)。
elements_zh.main_results: 在转化的 Mf 肾细胞、正常 Mf 肾细胞和 Vero 细胞中成功鉴定了所有靶基因(CD46、CD155、CD24、内皮唾液酸蛋白、vWF、PCNA 和 P53)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明转化的 Mf 肾细胞保留了与正常 Mf 肾细胞相似的分子特征,支持它们作为生物医学研究和 疫苗 开发的体外模型的潜在用途。以前没有进行过这种表征。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究表明,转化的 Mf 肾细胞可以作为 麻疹病毒 研究和 疫苗 开发的可靠体外模型,有可能改善临床前测试并减少对人源细胞的依赖。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于通过 PCR 进行的分子表征,不包括功能测定或直接的 麻疹病毒 感染研究,这削弱了结论的强度。该研究仅基于抽象级别的证据,进一步降低了可信度。

analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to molecular characterization via PCR and does not include functional assays or direct measles virus infection studies, which weakens the strength of the conclusions. The study is based solely on abstract-level evidence, further reducing confidence.

papers.title_zh: 文化转型与文化转型
papers.source_body_en: Satwa primata memiliki peran penting dalam penelitian biomedis karena memiliki kemiripan genetik dan fisiologis yang erat dengan manusia. Sel ginjal yang ditransformasi bersumber dari monyet ekor panjang (Mf) asal Indonesia telah berhasil dikembangkan untuk tujuan menjadi sel model in vitro dan pengembangan riset vaksin. Sel lestari dengan kualitas yang baik harus memiliki karakteristik yang sama dengan sel induknya. Karakterisasi sel ginjal transformasi Mf belum pernah dilakukan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk karakterisasi molekuler sel ginjal Mf yang dilakukan transformasi dengan mengkarakterisasi keberadaan gen reseptor virus, gen penekan tumor, dan gen proliferasi. Analisis dilakukan terhadap gen CD46 dan CD155 sebagai reseptor virus measles dan polio, gen endosialin, CD24, dan vWF sebagai penanda morfologi sel (fibroblast, epitel, dan endotel), serta gen PCNA dan P53 sebagai penanda proliferasi dan penekan tumor. Keberadaan gen dianalisis melalui teknik PCR. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa gen target dalam studi ini (CD46, CD155, CD24, endosialin, vWF, PCNA, dan P53) berhasil teridentifikasi dalam sel ginjal Mf transformasi, sel Vero dan sel ginjal Mf normal. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa secara molekuler sel ginjal Mf yang ditransformasi menunjukkan karakteristik secara molekuler yang sama dengan sel ginjal Mf normal dan berpotensi sebagai model sel untuk penelitian biomedis sebagai sediaan in vitro untuk pengembangan vaksin.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了生物医学研究(特别是 疫苗 开发)对源自非人类灵长类动物的体外细胞模型的需求,这些模型与人类细胞非常相似。它强调了印度尼西亚长尾猕猴(Macaca fasciculis)转化肾细胞分子特征方面的差距。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用分子技术对长尾猕猴 (Mf) 的转化肾细胞进行了表征。该研究的重点是来自印度尼西亚猕猴的细胞,并将转化细胞与正常肾细胞和 Vero 细胞进行比较。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用 PCR 分析靶基因的存在,以检测 麻疹病毒 受体(CD46 和 CD155)、细胞形态标记物(内皮唾液酸蛋白、CD24 和 vWF)以及增殖和肿瘤抑制标记物(PCNA 和 P53)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在转化的 Mf 肾细胞、正常 Mf 肾细胞和 Vero 细胞中成功鉴定了所有靶基因(CD46、CD155、CD24、内皮唾液酸蛋白、vWF、PCNA 和 P53)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明转化的 Mf 肾细胞保留了与正常 Mf 肾细胞相似的分子特征,支持它们作为生物医学研究和 疫苗 开发的体外模型的潜在用途。以前没有进行过这种表征。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究表明,转化的 Mf 肾细胞可以作为 麻疹病毒 研究和 疫苗 开发的可靠体外模型,有可能改善临床前测试并减少对人源细胞的依赖。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于通过 PCR 进行的分子表征,不包括功能测定或直接的 麻疹病毒 感染研究,这削弱了结论的强度。该研究仅基于抽象级别的证据,进一步降低了可信度。

papers.full_text: Abstract Skin diseases have a variety of causes, including exposure to chemicals, sunlight, viruses, bacteria, and other factors. Classification of skin diseases is essential because of their similar symptoms, such as red rashes, itching, and burning. The similar symptoms of the diseases make it difficult to distinguish them visually. This research aims to classify skin diseases using a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method. The dataset used is MSLD v2.0, which is skin disease image data with 6 classes, namely monkeypox, cowpox, chickenpox, measles, HFMD, and healthy. Hybrid CNN is an integration between the CNN model and machine learning methods. This research uses three CNN models, namely EfficientNet, DenseNet, and ResNet, as feature extraction. The classification methods used include logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost. Data augmentation is also applied to increase data variation. The highest performance results are obtained when using ResNet as a feature extraction and logistic regression as a classification method after going through the data augmentation process with an accuracy of 82% and a macro f1-score of 80%, which showed high performance in skin disease detection. Hybrid CNN with machine learning method shows the ability to feature extraction of skin disease images and achieves optimal performance.
